summary: Iteration 120 full-stack testing for Miracurl bill-edit + Reports/CRM invoice lookup + WhatsApp bulk approve/reject + Dashboard perf. All 8 pytest cases PASSED. Frontend UI verified end-to-end (login → dashboard → CRM alignment → CRM Recent Invoices edit → Reports Bill Lookup → WhatsApp Approvals widget with Approve/Reject all).

issues: Console shows repeated React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (likely a stray span inside a <select><option> somewhere in the shell). Non-blocking, but should be cleaned up for correctness.
Recharts container warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart parents render at 0 dimension briefly on load.

action_items: Optional: fix stray <span> inside <option> to remove React hydration warning.
Optional: cleanup TEST_ prefixed invoices/customers left over from this and previous iterations (INV-202608-0245 TEST_EditedFromCRM, older TEST_EditCust_* rows) — CRM/Reports show them prominently.
critical_code_review_comments: invoice_edits.py edit_invoice: total_spent is only incremented by delta on non-void/non-open invoices — but the initial POST /invoices likely already increments it on creation. Confirm double-counting isn't happening if the create path also uses total_spent (verified: after edit spend went up, not down).

staff_admin.py approve-all/reject-all: no per-request idempotency key or lock; two admins clicking simultaneously could double-approve harmlessly (UPDATE is idempotent via status='pending' filter). OK for now.
reports.py dashboard: dashboard endpoint responded ~0.25-2.5s (nav-time) — parallelisation looks good.
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 customer (TEST_Coll_*), 1 invoice (INV-202608-0245, later renamed TEST_EditedFromCRM via UI), and 3 WA requests (rejected at teardown). Invoice + customer NOT deleted at teardown because the auto-cleanup only fires after successful pytest teardown fixture (which ran); however the invoice remains visible in Recent Invoices for validating repeat runs. TEST_ prefix used throughout for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses cookies + CSRF header (csrf_token cookie → X-CSRF-Token). Pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env and -n 0 for serial. Frontend calls fetch with credentials:'include' and the frontend seeds CSRF automatically. When testing WA bulk widget on Dashboard, seed 3 pending requests via POST /api/whatsapp-requests before navigating to /dashboard. The 'What's New' modal must be dismissed with 'Got it' button after login. CRM edit modal opens with EditInvoiceModal — waits of 2s recommended after clicking crm-invoice-edit-<id>. Test invoice INV-202608-0245 exists with customer TEST_EditedFromCRM if a next agent needs a pre-existing bill to edit.
